add_asr_metrics: add ASR metrics including ctc_loss, num_examples, num_elements, total_num_examples, total_num_elements, and padding to a MetricBag
update_ctc_loss: update the CTC loss metric in a MetricBag by normalizing loss with batch size and converting to bits
update_asr_batch_metrics: update ASR batch metrics including num_examples, num_elements, total counts, and padding from a Seq2SeqBatch
review_add_asr_metrics: review the add_asr_metrics function that registers six ASR metrics on a fairseq2 MetricBag
summarize_update_ctc_loss: summarize the update_ctc_loss function that normalizes CTC loss by batch size and converts to log base 2 bits
